text: せんとうちゅうは　きゅうしょに　あたりやすくなる　どうぐ。

structure.jp: きゅうしょに　あたりやすくなる
structure.en: that makes it easier to hit a weak spot

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means it is easy or likely to happen. あたりやすく = 'easy to hit'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く plus なる means to become that way. あたりやすくなる = 'becomes easier to hit'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あたりやすくなる　どうぐ
patterns.explanation: Everything before どうぐ describes it, like 'that...' in English. あたりやすくなる どうぐ = 'an item that makes hits land more easily'.
